terms.label: Abstract
terms.definition: A summary of the resource.

terms.label: Access Rights
terms.definition: Information about who access the resource or an indication of its security status.

terms.label: Accrual Method
terms.definition: The method by which items are added to a collection.

terms.label: Accrual Periodicity
terms.definition: The frequency with which items are added to a collection.

terms.label: Accrual Policy
terms.definition: The policy governing the addition of items to a collection.

terms.label: Alternative Title
terms.definition: An alternative name for the resource.

terms.label: Audience
terms.definition: A class of agents for whom the resource is intended or useful.

terms.label: Date Available
terms.definition: Date that the resource became or will become available.

terms.label: Bibliographic Citation
terms.definition: A bibliographic reference for the resource.

terms.label: Conforms To
terms.definition: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.

terms.label: Contributor
terms.definition: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.

terms.label: Coverage
terms.definition: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, spatial applicability of the resource, or jurisdiction under which the resource is relevant.

terms.label: Date Created
terms.definition: Date of creation of the resource.

terms.label: Creator
terms.definition: An entity responsible for making the resource.

terms.label: Date
terms.definition: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

terms.label: Date Accepted
terms.definition: Date of acceptance of the resource.

terms.label: Date Copyrighted
terms.definition: Date of copyright of the resource.

terms.label: Date Submitted
terms.definition: Date of submission of the resource.

terms.label: Description
terms.definition: An account of the resource.

terms.label: Audience Education Level
terms.definition: A class of agents, defined in terms of progression through an educational or training context, for which the described resource is intended.

terms.label: Extent
terms.definition: The size or duration of the resource.

terms.label: Format
terms.definition: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

terms.label: Has Format
terms.definition: A related resource that is substantially the same as the pre-existing described resource, but in another format.

terms.label: Has Part
terms.definition: A related resource that is included either physically or logically in the described resource.

terms.label: Has Version
terms.definition: A related resource that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described resource.

terms.label: Identifier
terms.definition: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

terms.label: Instructional Method
terms.definition: A process, used to engender knowledge, attitudes and skills, that the described resource is designed to support.

terms.label: Is Format Of
terms.definition: A pre-existing related resource that is substantially the same as the described resource, but in another format.

terms.label: Is Part Of
terms.definition: A related resource in which the described resource is physically or logically included.

terms.label: Is Referenced By
terms.definition: A related resource that references, cites, or otherwise points to the described resource.

terms.label: Is Replaced By
terms.definition: A related resource that supplants, displaces, or supersedes the described resource.

terms.label: Is Required By
terms.definition: A related resource that requires the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

terms.label: Is Version Of
terms.definition: A related resource of which the described resource is a version, edition, or adaptation.

terms.label: Date Issued
terms.definition: Date of formal issuance of the resource.

terms.label: Language
terms.definition: A language of the resource.

terms.label: License
terms.definition: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

terms.label: Mediator
terms.definition: An entity that mediates access to the resource.

terms.label: Medium
terms.definition: The material or physical carrier of the resource.

terms.label: Date Modified
terms.definition: Date on which the resource was changed.

terms.label: Provenance
terms.definition: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

terms.label: Publisher
terms.definition: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

terms.label: References
terms.definition: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.

terms.label: Relation
terms.definition: A related resource.

terms.label: Replaces
terms.definition: A related resource that is supplanted, displaced, or superseded by the described resource.

terms.label: Requires
terms.definition: A related resource that is required by the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

terms.label: Rights
terms.definition: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

terms.label: Rights Holder
terms.definition: A person or organization owning or managing rights over the resource.

terms.label: Source
terms.definition: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

terms.label: Spatial Coverage
terms.definition: Spatial characteristics of the resource.

terms.label: Subject
terms.definition: A topic of the resource.

terms.label: Table Of Contents
terms.definition: A list of subunits of the resource.

terms.label: Temporal Coverage
terms.definition: Temporal characteristics of the resource.

terms.label: Title
terms.definition: A name given to the resource.

terms.label: Type
terms.definition: The nature or genre of the resource.

terms.label: Date Valid
terms.definition: Date (often a range) of validity of a resource.
